sources.snippet: Aureon never predicts a single price. Every forecast carries direction probabilities, an expected return, a confidence score, and a prediction interval, and every trade must clear a risk gate that can veto the AI.

sources.snippet: Website · API · Model workshop · Desktop & Android A financial intelligence platform: real market data, probabilistic AI forecasting, an independent risk engine, and a TradingView-style workspace for trading it — in demo or, when explicitly enabled, live. Aureon never predicts a single price.
